title: Sean McVay won’t name Rams’ QB2, but may have already tipped his hand

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay won’t name Rams’ QB2, but may have already tipped his hand
sources.description: Sean McVay insists the Rams’ backup quarterback battle remains undecided, but his preseason decisions suggest Stetson Bennett IV has the edge over Ty Simpson.
